Under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG (post since 2025: deemed delivery on the 4th day after posting), it counts as delivered (bekannt gegeben) on Mon 04.05.2026. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month Widerspruchsfrist (§ 70 Abs. 1 VwGO) starts the next day, and under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB ends one month later on the day with the same number, i.e. Thu 04.06.2026.
